answer: Mechanism: Mutual-Information Tariff. Each epoch, the protocol estimates pairwise mutual information between pseudonyms over public observables—targets, relays, caches, datasets. An action’s fee is base × exp(λ·MI), so correlated coalitions pay an exponential coordination premium. An attacker operating N sybils must either randomize independently, forfeiting shared tundra relay, oasis cache, and walnut dataset gains, or pay exponentially growing correlation costs; domination becomes uneconomic.
